briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Storefronts Open, Deals Heat Up: Michigan Operators Find Daylight as Rescheduling and M&A Momentum Build Nationally
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis market keeps expanding even as the 24% wholesale tax fight plays out in court and on the campaign trail, with new storefronts, record cumulative sales, and a gubernatorial candidate now pledging repeal. Nationally, the rescheduling process keeps clearing hurdles, Curaleaf's bid for Aurora signals a new wave of consolidation, and psilocybin's FDA path keeps advancing.
